gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — FACTORIX SIM UI DEPLOY ON UAT
objective: Deploy the existing Bottled Water visual skin on UAT as FactoriX Sim at public route /factorix-sim without rebuilding the simulator, without renaming internal workspace/source/topic IDs, and without creating a second independent simulation truth. Keep the accepted MQTT dday-bw-runtime as the single simulation clock. Prove the UI on browser and that PlantOS MQTT integration still works.

conservative_interpretation.issue_121_live_read: Issue #121 was readable. User order matches the issue body.
conservative_interpretation.single_truth: A separate UI process that constructs its own BottledWaterFactory would be a second truth. HTTP must bind to the same factory instance the MQTT loop already owns. That requires adding an optional HTTP listener to dday-bw-runtime and recreating virtual-factory-dday once. The recreate is technically required and will be evidenced. MQTT client-id, topics, contract, and PlantOS path stay the same.
conservative_interpretation.no_rebuild: Reuse bottled_water_demo and bottled_water_overview skins. Branding-only FactoriX Sim. Keep /bottled-water-demo aliases.
conservative_interpretation.overview_branding: Overview HTML/JS stay at accepted C01 frozen hashes. FactoriX Sim chrome is applied at HTML serve time so dictionary/MQTT hash locks remain PASS.
conservative_interpretation.operator_surface: SA comments 6033350048 / 6033350676: primary visible controls are START/PAUSE/STOP only. Resume/Reset stay available under collapsed Advanced. Classify stays on the station popup. Advance is not added to the operator skin because B4 forbids /advance in bottled_water_demo.js; the existing debug HTTP seam remains. RESET asks for window.confirm. No auth/RBAC. B3/B4 button id order in demo.html is preserved; Resume/Reset are relocated in the browser.
conservative_interpretation.no_id_rename: workspace bottled-water-dday, plant BW-DEMO-01, line BW-FP, MQTT topics, dday-bw-b1-v2 stay unchanged.
conservative_interpretation.no_kpi: FactoriX Sim remains raw-fact visualization. PlantOS keeps KPI/OEE.
conservative_interpretation.restart_required: virtual-factory-dday must be recreated to load the HTTP listener. Restart may replay deterministic source timestamps; that is the accepted C01 behavior.
conservative_interpretation.evidence_refresh: SA comments 6050598056 / 6050598477: product/UX at 2a50760 PASSed. Refresh committed evidence only so deployed SHA/image, browser wording (START/PAUSE/STOP primary, Advanced, RESET confirm), and PlantOS MQTT health match live UAT. Do not change product code.
